investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ironidian Shop (online retail); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.112.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ironid-prod-cacent (EKS); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for web-bff; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
